title: AI Cold Email & LinkedIn DM Generator for Tech Jobs & Internships | techcadd Lucknow
metaDescription: Free AI cold email and LinkedIn message generator for developers, engineering students, and tech freshers. Create high-response cold emails, follow-ups, and 300-character LinkedIn connection notes tailored for internships and off-campus placements.

hero.eyebrow: Free AI Outreach Tool · Tailored for Developers & Students
hero.text: Stop sending boring messages that get ignored. Generate personalized, high-response cold emails, follow-ups, and 300-character LinkedIn notes that get you tech interviews.

formPanel.heading: 1. Outreach Setup & Audience
formPanel.text: Select your target profile to generate a high-response outreach message.

inputs.name: track
inputs.label: Your Target Tech Track
inputs.onChange: resets skills & project fields to the track's defaultSkills/defaultProject

inputs.name: recipientType
inputs.label: Who Are You Messaging?
inputs.note: Selectable but NOT used in any template (cosmetic only).

inputs.name: variation
inputs.label: Regenerate Variation
inputs.logic: toggles 0/1; only changes the internship email subject (style 1 vs style 2)

logic: NOT AI — purely client-side string templates, regenerated live on every keystroke. trackShort = track.label.split('(')[0].trim() (e.g. 'Full Stack Developer'). Fallbacks: email uses recipient||'Hiring Team' and company||'your engineering team'; LinkedIn note uses recipient||'there' and company||'your team'; DM uses recipient||'there' and company||'your company'. Goal 'fresher_job' and 'feedback' both use the default (else) branch. firstTwoSkills = skills.split(',').slice(0,2).join(','). LinkedIn note shows 'Character Count: {len} / 300 characters' (red if >300, green otherwise) and a status 'Over 300 Chars Limit' / 'Safe to Send ✓'. Copy buttons write to clipboard and show 'Copied!'/'Copied All!' for 2.5s. Copy Full Email copies 'Subject: {subject}\n\n{body}'.

sections.heading: The 4-Part Structure of a High-Conversion Developer Cold Email
sections.text: Engineered to be read in under 15 seconds on mobile devices by busy engineering managers and founders.

items.title: 1. The Relevance Hook
items.text: Never start with 'I hope this finds you well.' Start with genuine recognition of what their engineering team or company just shipped.

items.title: 2. Tangible Code Proof
items.text: Claims mean nothing without proof. Mention your live deployed capstone and GitHub link right in the second paragraph.

items.title: 3. Clear Immediate Value
items.text: Explain what tasks you can take off their plate immediately (shipping frontend components, resolving backlog bugs, writing automated unit tests).

items.title: 4. Zero-Friction CTA
items.text: Don't ask for a 30-minute interview. Ask for a casual 10-minute introductory call or invite them to glance at your repository.

faqs.q: Why do cold emails work better than standard job portal applications?
faqs.a: Standard job boards (Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs) receive 500+ applicants within 2 hours for a single opening, creating intense competition where resumes get lost in ATS filters. Cold emailing an engineering manager or founder directly puts your live project proof directly in their primary inbox with zero competition.

faqs.q: What is the secret to high reply rates on LinkedIn connection notes?
faqs.a: Keep it strictly under 300 characters, personalize the recipient's name, mention 1-2 core skills, and provide a direct link to your code or project proof. Do not pitch immediately in the connection note; establish mutual technical respect first.

faqs.q: Why is the follow-up email so important?
faqs.a: Industry data and techcadd placement cell records show that over 65% of positive responses happen on the second follow-up email sent 3-4 days later. Recruiters and founders are busy; a polite, value-adding follow-up demonstrates persistence and professionalism.

faqs.q: Can I use these templates for 6 Months Industrial Training applications?
faqs.a: Yes! The generator includes specialized templates designed specifically for final-year B.Tech, BCA, MCA, and Polytechnic students applying for approved 6 Months Industrial Training internships.

faqs.q: How does techcadd Lucknow support students in reaching recruiters?
faqs.a: In addition to teaching full-stack coding and live project engineering, techcadd Lucknow's dedicated placement cell directly connects students with our network of 800+ hiring partners, arranges offline campus drives, and reviews portfolio outreach materials.
